reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner in Bareni's calm, pragmatic voice. It respects the zero-CTA constraint and highlights human-in-the-loop control.
reasons.clarity: The argument develops logically and clearly from framing the problem as a workflow issue to offering criteria for when AI fits or doesn't.
